question: What was the esteemed category of civilian honours conferred upon legendary Indian hockey player PR Sreejesh by President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Awards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PR Sreejesh**, the veteran goalkeeper of the **Indian Men’s Hockey Team**, was conferred with the **Padma Shri** (which falls under the **Padma Awards** category) for his distinguished service in the field of **Sports**.
 
• The honor was presented by **President Droupadi Murmu** during a civil investiture ceremony held at **Rashtrapati Bhavan** in **April 2025**.
 
• Sreejesh is widely recognized as one of the greatest goalkeepers in the history of hockey, often referred to as **"The Wall"** for his exceptional reflexes and leadership on the field.
 
• He played a pivotal role in ending India's 41-year Olympic medal drought by helping the team secure the **Bronze Medal** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** and subsequently defending the title at the **Paris 2024 Olympics**.
 
• The **Padma Awards** are one of the highest civilian honors of the country, announced annually on the eve of **Republic Day** (January 26th).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PR Sreejesh's Accolades:**
 
 
• Before the Padma Shri, he was honored with the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in **2021**, which is India's highest sporting honor.
 
• He was also the recipient of the **Arjuna Award** in **2015** and was named the **World Games Athlete of the Year 2021**, becoming only the second Indian to win this global award.
 
• Hailing from **Kerala**, he served as the **Captain** of the Indian national team during the **2016 Rio Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **The Padma Awards:**
 
 
• Instituted in **1954**, these awards are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (distinguished service in any field).
 
• The awards seek to recognize achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved, such as **Art, Social Work, Public Affairs, Science and Engineering, Trade and Industry, Medicine, Literature and Education, Sports, and Civil Service**.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Awards:**
 
 
• These are separate from civilian honors and include the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna**, **Arjuna Award**, **Dronacharya Award** (for coaches), and **Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement**.
 
• These are usually conferred by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** on **National Sports Day** (August 29).
 
 
 
• **Bharat Ratna:**
 
 
• This is the **highest civilian award** of the **Republic of India**. It is awarded in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavor.
